titulo: Darle a alguien por (hacer) algo = to suddenly take up something
subtitulo: Le dio por correr. Me ha dado por cocinar.
regla: Darle a alguien por + infinitive or noun = to suddenly get into something, take it up on a whim: Le dio por correr maratones. Dar stays in the third person singular; the person is the indirect pronoun.

partes: me / te / le / nos / les + da (dio, ha dado...)

bloques.texto: It expresses a **sudden interest or habit**, with no warning: _he got it into his head to..._, _she's taken to..._
**Dar** is always **third person singular**: **le dio**, **nos dio**, never ~~les dieron~~ for this meaning.
The person is the indirect pronoun, and you can add **a** + person: **a mi mamá le dio por...**
Very common in Mexico: **¿Y ahora qué te dio por hacer?**
Tip: **darle por** = a bug bit you.

lista.es: A mi mamá ==le ha dado por== llamarme todas las noches. Me tiene vigilada.
lista.en: My mom has taken to calling me every night. She's keeping tabs on me.

lista.es: Ayer ==me dio por== limpiar la cocina a fondo. Terminé agotada.
lista.en: Yesterday I suddenly decided to deep-clean the kitchen. I ended up exhausted.

lista.es: Últimamente ==le ha dado por== coquetear con su jefe.
lista.en: Lately she's taken to flirting with her boss.

lista.es: El año pasado ==nos dio por== el golf y este año por el tenis.
lista.en: Last year we got into golf and this year it's tennis.

lista.es: De repente ==le dio por== aprender a surfear.
lista.en: Out of nowhere he decided to learn to surf.

lista.nota: The person is the indirect pronoun.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _My dad has taken up gardening._
lista.r: A mi papá le ha dado por la jardinería. / le dio por la jardinería.

lista.p: In Spanish: _We suddenly decided to dance._
Fix it: _A ellos les dieron por viajar._
lista.r: A ellos les dio por viajar.
